m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Zope Broad Seer? He traded with us, yes, and then said he wanted to collect some berries in Saltmeadow Swamp.
I believe he was going to search near that strange shipwreck for his berries. Maybe the peculiar, furry Monquistans saw him.
Those Monquistans do not speak to us. Savages. You may have to show fang and claw to get them to talk.
Thank you, young one. You may return to Cantares Five Flowers and tell him that I am once again free.
Thank you, Outsider. Again, you have proven your prowess.
Magician, I am concerned. There is a local Wise Man, Zope Broad Seer, who I have not heard from for several days.
I am worried that some tragedy has befallen Zope. Last I knew he went to trade with Techotl Redsmoke in Mangrove Marsh.
Please speak to Techotl and see if you can ensure Wise Man Zope Broad Seer is well and good.
Talk to Techotl Redsmoke in Mangrove Marsh and see if he knows where our missing Wise Man might be.
